scope.unit: Unique HTTP method + normalized path; /users/me uses /users/{user_id}.
scope.included: Documented /api/v4 REST operations plus literal core api4 HTTP route registrations, including conditional registrations. Five documented local-only operations are retained and labeled for comparison, not counted as registered HTTP endpoints.
scope.excluded: Local socket routes, /api/v5, plugin-defined APIs, WebSocket operations, root endpoints, and catch-all 404 handlers.
scope.permission_metadata: Lexical references only, not an evaluated permission policy. Empty/missing lists do not mean unrestricted access. Handler helpers, app logic, account roles, membership, licenses and configuration remain authoritative.
scope.coverage: Convenience tools cover 33 method/path pairs; api_call dispatches every session/public core HTTP operation through a pinned catalog. api_search and api_describe are local discovery only. Special cloud/remote-cluster authentication and local-socket operations are catalogued but cannot use the configured account credential. Coverage is transport exposure, not a claim that every PAT has the required account permissions, license, features, input variants or live compatibility.
